author: Cleo Abram
description:
There’s antimatter in this truck!!

And if matter meets antimatter…it goes boom!

We’ve figured out how to make and store antimatter, but they’re super delicate atoms, so to study them we need a super quiet environment that requires moving them!

So scientists built a special trap in order to transport antimatter…

#shorts #science #CERN #antimatter #physics
title: There’s Antimatter In This Truck
